scope: Local emulator observation of the supplied Spectron 2.2 package
network_scope: The emulator had ordinary networking enabled. This run was not a no-network control, and no production endpoint result is claimed.

inputs.emulator: Android API 36 x86_64 with ARM64 native translation

procedure.action: Launch the supplied package, then tap Start on its custom green menu.

static_correlation.behavior: The dispatcher compares a WebTop message with crash, then the selected branch stores through a null address and loops.

interpretation: The observed death is an intentional WebTop crash command, not evidence that qplay itself failed at the reported instruction.
The qplay scoped-storage write failures were recorded in the same run but are a separate issue and were not proven to cause the SIGSEGV.
Because network contact was not independently audited for this run, it does not establish whether the Spectron package can complete a live login or render a playable world.
